gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Authentic kacchi dum biryani cooked with marinated tender chicken, long-grain basmati rice, aromatic saffron, and fried onions. Served with mirchi ka salan and raita.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Royal Mutton Dum Biryani
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Succulent baby goat mutton slow-cooked in handi with shahi garam masalas, kewra water, and pure ghee basmati rice. Served with spicy salan.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Special Boneless Chicken Biryani
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Juicy boneless chicken cubes spiced with crushed pepper and green chilies, layered over fragrant spiced saffron rice.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Chicken 65 Biryani
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Crispy spicy Chicken 65 tossed with curry leaves and green chilies, layered on dum biryani rice with boiled egg.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Hyderabadi Veg Dum Biryani
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Seasonal farm-fresh vegetables, baby potatoes, and French beans slow-cooked with whole spices and basmati rice in dum style. Served with boondi raita.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Paneer Tikka Dum Biryani
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Char-grilled cottage cheese cubes coated in Kashmiri tandoori spices, layered over aromatic saffron dum rice with mint and brown onions.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Spicy Prawns Biryani
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Fresh coastal tiger prawns sautéed in spiced coconut-onion gravy, layered with royal basmati rice and fried cashews.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Egg Dum Biryani (Double Egg)
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Pan-fried golden boiled eggs coated with spices, nestled in rich aromatic dum biryani rice. Served with cooling raita.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Shawarma
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Juicy spiced shredded chicken wrapped in warm pita bread with garlic toum sauce, pickles, and crispy fries.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Crispy Chicken 65
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Deep-fried chicken pieces tossed in yogurt, spicy red chili sauce, garlic, and fresh curry leaves.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Paneer 65 Crispy
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Golden fried paneer cubes tempered with mustard seeds, curd, green chilies, and South Indian curry spices.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Chilli Chicken Dry
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Indo-Chinese style crispy chicken wok-tossed with spring onions, crunchy bell peppers, and spicy soya glaze.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Crispy Corn Salt & Pepper
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Sweet golden corn kernels tossed with cracked black pepper, fresh lemon juice, scallions, and herbs.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Apollo Fish Fry
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Boneless fish fillets fried crisp and tossed in Hyderabadi spicy yogurt tadka with green chillies.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Tandoori Chicken (Half / Full)
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Chicken bone-in marinated with hung curd, ginger garlic paste, and Kashmiri degi mirch, roasted in clay tandoor.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Murgh Malai Kebab
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Melt-in-mouth chicken breast cubes marinated in heavy clotted cream, cheese, cardamom, and white pepper.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Tandoori Paneer Tikka
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Fresh malai paneer cubes skewered with capsicum and diced onions, char-grilled to perfection.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Mutton Seekh Kebab
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Minced lamb blended with mint, fresh coriander, ginger, and royal spices, roasted golden on charcoal skewers.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Classic Butter Chicken
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Char-smoked shredded chicken simmered in rich velvety tomato, butter, and cashew nut gravy finished with kasuri methi.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Kadai Chicken Masala
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Tender chicken tossed with chunky capsicum, tomatoes, and freshly ground coriander-cumin spices in an iron wok.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Shahi Paneer Butter Masala
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Cottage cheese cooked in a silky, mildly sweet spiced tomato-butter gravy topped with fresh cream.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Dal Makhani Bukhara
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Black lentils slow-cooked overnight over charcoal with butter, tomato purée, and cream for ultimate richness.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Mutton Rogan Josh
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Kashmiri delicacy of tender mutton cooked in aromatic gravy flavored with ratan jot and Kashmiri chilies.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Butter Garlic Naan
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Fluffy refined flour bread topped with minced garlic and cilantro, baked in tandoor and brushed with melted amul butter.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Cheese Garlic Naan
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Tandoori naan stuffed with melted mozzarella cheese and topped with crushed garlic.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Tandoori Roti (Butter)
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Whole wheat flatbread baked crisp in the clay oven and buttered.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Royal Mango Lassi
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Thick creamy yogurt churned with sweet Alphonso mango pulp, saffron, and crushed pistachios.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Sweet Punjabi Lassi
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Traditional Punjabi churned curd beverage topped with fresh malai and kewra essence.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Fresh Masala Lemonade
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Chilled soda or water infused with fresh lemon juice, roasted cumin, black salt, and mint leaves.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Spiced Buttermilk (Chaas)
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Refreshing curd drink spiced with crushed ginger, green chili, roasted cumin, and fresh cilantro.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Ice cream
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Gourmet trio scoops of rich Belgian chocolate, Madagascar vanilla, and strawberry ice cream topped with waffle crisps.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Gulab Jamun with Rabdi (2 Pcs)
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Hot khoya dumplings soaked in rose-cardamom sugar syrup, served over chilled thick saffron rabdi.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Royal Shahi Tukda
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Hyderabadi dessert of ghee-fried crisp bread soaked in saffron syrup, coated with thickened condensed milk and nuts.

gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.name: Matka Kulfi Falooda
gourmet_pos_menu_items_v2.description: Creamy malai kulfi served with rose falooda sev, sabja basil seeds, and pure rose syrup.
